title: Decision tree
description: The first answers of a scheme and the answers that follow from each, down to the foundation values they set. Drawn by the DecisionTree composite under Where it starts on the Decision reference.

roots.description: The first answers: those that follow from no other answer.

answer.description: The scheme's answer, as its short label.

question.description: The question it answers. A foundation value has none.

also.description: The other answers it also follows from, as their labels.

scope.description: The foundation whose values this answer sets, for a leaf.

title.description: The foundation's name, such as spacing.

href.description: The link to the foundation's page, relative to this page.

token.description: One token it sets, such as space.gap.tight.

primitive.description: The primitive that token ends at.

children.description: The answers that follow from this one.
